messages:
alex: Heads-up — saw a spike of 413s on /v1/embeddings this morning from ClientX. They send mixed-dim arrays in one request (64, 1536) and our splitter is creating 3 shards and blowing past per-request payload limit.

mira: ugh. are we failing early? should return 4xx with reason 'mixed_dims' not 413.

jamal: current behavior: router blindly concatenates and counts bytes; max_payload_bytes=4MB -> splitter emits 413 when single subbatch > 4MB. We have dim-slot accounting that charges slot=ceil(dim/256) and quota per-slot. ClientX is charged double.

patrick: can we do affinity: group by dims before batching? that'll increase latency for small clients.

mira: propose new header X-Embed-Dim to tell router preferred grouping. Also a soft-fail path: return 200 with per-item error for items we can't fit and include 'split_hint'.

alex: sample logs:
```json
{"route":"embeds-prod","payload_bytes":4123456,"items":[{"dim":1536},{"dim":64}]}
```

console-bot: Added alert EMBED_413_SPIKE to #eng-sre :rotating_light:

jamal: telemetry needs metrics: embed.request.items, embed.request.max_dim, embed.response.split_count, embed.traces.routing_affinity. current dashboard shows only tokens/second.

patrick: UX: in Console we should show per-route 'effective slot usage' and simulated cost if they sent with preferred grouping. Also flag clients doing mixed dims.

mira: rollout plan: feature-flag dim_slot_v2 on canary with header opt-in. After 2 weeks promote.

infra-bot: PR #4827 created: router: group by dim hash, add X-Embed-Dim opt-in, emit telemetry events; tests failing for sparse batches.

alex: ok let's do canary. assign jamal for telemetry, mira for router, patrick for console card. I'll post rollout checklist. :thumbsup:

sre-oncall: monitor latency p50 and p95, and cost delta. watch for tail latency increase.

jamal: note: need to reconcile quota accounting: current quota API expects 'units' int; new per-dim slots need a mapping table. I'll draft migration.

mira: thanks all. next: sync tomorrow 10am.
